summary: Reuse a bounded process-local workflow index for repeated pages of terminal runs and invalidate it after classification corrections.
decision_refs: The active goal requires continued workflow efficiency
The existing pagination endpoint projects and rebuilds every workflow group for each requested page
Reviewer corrections must be immediately visible and therefore invalidate terminal-run cache entries
approval_evidence: The persistent user goal explicitly requests continued efficiency for RFI, Submittal and Email support.
known_limitations: The cache is process-local and bounded to eight terminal runs; multi-process shared caching remains unimplemented.
Active runs remain uncached so partial parser progress stays visible.
Validation is synthetic and offline; no customer file, provider or paid model is used.
